_comment: EXAMPLE. This is not the real config. Copy it to your user config with 'python -m claude_informes init' and replace these fictitious paths with your own. This file, versioned in the repo, MUST NOT contain any real path of anyone.
_keys_are_english: English is the only supported spelling. The old Castilian keys (proyectos, cwd, nombre, activo, umbral_lineas, raiz_informes, ruta_log) are still read as TRANSITIONAL compatibility aliases and will be removed in 2.0.0. Do not write them in a new config.
_reports_root: Global archive root. It MUST live OUTSIDE any git repository: the reports carry the full text of sessions and must not end up versioned or on a remote. Each project can override it.
_roots: Watched containers: every immediate child directory is a project. A session started in <root>/alfa/src is archived under 'alfa'. Most projects need nothing more than this.
_exclusions: Glob patterns. A resolved project whose path (or bare name) matches one is NOT archived. '*-audit*' keeps audit clones out of the archive.
_projects: OPTIONAL. An entry is needed only to override a default, or to name a standalone project that does not hang off a watched root. A project discovered under a root needs no entry.

projects._note: A standalone project (not under any root): the whole subtree is one project. Here with a higher line_threshold than the global 5, so it is an override: only longer turns are archived.
projects.name: standalone-tool

projects._note: A sensitive project archived to its own root, OUTSIDE the global one.
projects.name: privado
